Agent Name: WebSurfer  
Step Number: 4  
Reason for Mistake: The WebSurfer’s first search was too imprecise and failed to identify the exact June 6, 2023 Universe Today article directly. It searched broadly for “Carolyn Collins Petersen article June 6, 2023 site:universetoday.com,” which surfaced multiple possible articles and led the team to focus on the wrong one initially. The actual relevant article was later found to be “There Are Hundreds of Mysterious Filaments at the Center of the Milky Way,” so the initial search misdirected the investigation and caused unnecessary looping.
